NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots now show a very long name breaking the pill and then truncated |
| ✅  | PR description explains how this differs from #39049, #39829 and #39768 |
| ✅  | Truncation no longer hits normal names (`max-width` raised to `15em`, pushed after the feedback) |
| ✅  | Author commented asking for another look (but pinged @alya, not the triager) |
| ❌  | Commits are not clean: "fix: increase max-width…" and "css(reactions): avoid animating font-weight…" are fixups that should be squashed into the main commit |
| ℹ️  | CI passes. Per the #design thread, Alya wants part of every reactor's name visible. This pure CSS fix truncates the whole comma-joined string, and #39768 (per-name truncation) is already in maintainer review |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to squash the commits. A maintainer may also want to decide whether this approach is worth pursuing next to #39768.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updated screenshots and the comparison with the other PRs! Please squash the two follow-up commits into the main one (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)), and also explain how this behaves when several people react, since names are shown together in that case.
```
